### NAME

`bulk_extractor` - Extracts features (emails, URLs, cards) from disk images without parsing the filesystem.

### SYNOPSIS & usage

*Derived from the upstream README at generation
time; verify against `--help` where the tool is
installed.*

```
git clone https://github.com/simsong/bulk_extractor.git
./bootstrap.sh
./configure
make
make check
make install
```

### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

`bulk_extractor` is a high-performance digital forensics exploitation tool.  It is a "get evidence" button that rapidly scans any kind of input (disk images, files, directories of files, etc) and extracts structured information such as email addresses, credit card numbers, JPEGs and JSON snippets without parsing the file system or file system structures.
